# Retained DAO regression inputs

These files have unchanged bytes from commit `6f78a0840feafdb26e8256e7212529156beb6c72`, under `docs/apps/dao/delivery/evidence/m5-live/`.
See the [original evidence explanation](../../../docs/apps/dao/delivery/evidence/m5-live/README.md).

- `producer-created.json`: released producer acquisition from a local fork; content retrieval was disabled.
- `fork-execution.json`: a separately constructed, receipt-backed execution fixture, not producer output.
- `local-deployments.json`: local test configuration, not an approved production allowlist.

The original [checksum manifest](../../../docs/apps/dao/delivery/evidence/m5-live/artifact-sha256.json) remains historical and unchanged.
These fixtures test parsing and interoperability. They do not claim a new live acquisition.
